checklist_items.label: must be public HTTP(S)
checklist_items.operator_check: Use a normal http or https page that can be opened without credentials.

checklist_items.label: must not require login
checklist_items.operator_check: Do not use pages behind accounts, KYC, paywalls, or identity gates.

checklist_items.label: must not require API key
checklist_items.operator_check: Do not use URLs that depend on tokens, API keys, signatures, or private headers.

checklist_items.label: must not require cookies
checklist_items.operator_check: Do not use browser-session URLs or profile-specific links.

checklist_items.label: must not be wallet, order, or trading endpoint
checklist_items.operator_check: Use read-only public reference pages only.

checklist_items.label: must not be a private dashboard
checklist_items.operator_check: Avoid private dashboards, admin pages, local tools, and account-specific views.

checklist_items.label: must not be localhost or internal IP
checklist_items.operator_check: Do not use localhost, private IP ranges, internal hostnames, or intranet links.

checklist_items.label: should be official or high-quality public reference
checklist_items.operator_check: Prefer official market, resolution, benchmark, or durable public reference pages.

checklist_items.label: should map clearly to expected evidence type
checklist_items.operator_check: The URL should visibly support the evidence type named in the packet row.

checklist_items.label: should be stable enough for future replay
checklist_items.operator_check: Prefer durable pages over ephemeral search results, interactive state, or personalized views.

source_category_checklist.expected_evidence_type: public market metadata, rules, status, and linked reference snapshot
source_category_checklist.operator_goal: Find one concrete public URL that matches this evidence type and passes the checklist.
